    Lemma 9.4 along arbitrary ordinary paths #

    lem:one-sided-path-coefficients (integral-partial-lifts.tex): for a generating left-sided ray r, an ordinary path of r with two-sided prefix p and first left-sided arrow a, the value d_r = [p] + X_a does not depend on the chosen path, and neither does a. Dually d_s = Y_b + [p'] for a generating right-sided ray s.

    IntegralLifting.lean defines d_r (DL) by a recursion on unique first arrows. Here the manuscript's definition is given (dPath, dPathR: read along a chosen ordinary path, which exists, exists_ordPath) and shown equal to it (dPath_eq_DL, dPathR_eq_DR), so the product equations DL_prod, DR_prod hold for it. The value read along any ordinary path is DL r (dL_eq_pathCoef), the first arrow of the path which is not two-sided (fstNB) exists and is left-sided, and it is the same for all paths (fstNB_unique). The dual statements read the reversed path (dR_eq_pathCoef, lstNB_unique). The product equations with generating one-sided output are DL_prod and DR_prod.
